relationships.subject: GluK1
relationships.evidence_quote: Inhibiting KA GluK1 receptors may reduce chronic pain-related anxiety by reducing or inhibiting pre-LTP.

relationships.subject: oxytocin
relationships.evidence_quote: Application of oxytocin selectively blocks the maintenance of pre-LTP but not post-LTP.

relationships.subject: NB001
relationships.evidence_quote: NB001 is found to inhibit pre-LTP in both ACC and IC

relationships.subject: ACC
relationships.evidence_quote: Inhibiting ACC activity by microinjection of the inhibitory receptor agonist mucimol produced significant reduction of anxiety-like behaviors in mice.

key_findings: Pre-LTP in the ACC contributes to chronic pain-related anxiety and is a drug target (GluK1, AC1/NB001, HCN, oxytocin).
PVT subregions drive pain versus anxiety via distinct projections to BLA and CeA.
